description: This header file declares cryptographic functions related to the EAD (possibly an encryption/decryption module) used in the project. It includes function prototypes for setting a key, encrypting, and decrypting messages, and references a data structure 'struct ead_msg'.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic key for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts a message given in an 'ead_msg' structure.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts a message contained within an 'ead_msg' structure.
